summary_md: **Oleg Oratovsky ([@olegoratovsky](https://x.com/olegoratovsky/status/2115869113436524880))** argues that Uncle Bob's TDD skill over-specifies steps; saying "use TDD" should suffice, with instructions targeted at the mistakes the agent actually makes ([ub-mode SKILL.md](https://github.com/unclebob/ub-mode/blob/master/SKILL.md)).
relevance: Skill-writing philosophy: correct observed failures, not restate known practice.
